# Phil Gordon

[Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college)

- **Nicknames:** Phil  <sub>[v3 ch.Lady P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028), [v3 ch.Confidences P1](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0001)</sub>

## Appearance

Phil Gordon is characterized by big brown eyes and a crooked smile. Her appearance features distinctive brown tints, and she wears her hair in curls.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Interlude P5](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0005), [v3 ch.Confidences P3](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0003)_

## Personality

Phil Gordon is a pretty, sweet, and goodhearted individual who, despite being a bit thoughtless, is a loyal soul free from snobbishness. Highly motivated, she aims to earn the Johnson Scholarship in Mathematics, and she has acquired practical skills such as washing dishes and sweeping floors. Additionally, she harbors a deep dread of scarlet fever.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Home P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 ch.Place P65](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0065), [v3 ch.Relationships P66](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0066), [v3 ch.Interlude P37](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0037), [v3 ch.Jonas P1](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0001), [v3 ch.Confidences P2](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0002)_

## History

Philippa "Phil" Gordon, the daughter of a prominent, wealthy man from an exclusive Bluenose family in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke), [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia), grew up attending church—where her grandmother would give her peppermints—and once spent an entire summer teaching a Sunday school class. After enrolling at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) in [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport), she first met [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) while wandering through Old St. John's Cemetery. An exuberant and talkative student torn between two suitors, [Alec](../character/alec.md) and [Alonzo](../character/alonzo.md), Phil quickly became close friends with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md), later enthusiastically begging to move into Patty's Place with them, [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md), and [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) for their sophomore year. Over the summer, while staying at a boarding house in [Prospect Point](../codex/places.md#prospect-point), Phil met an ugly but earnest divinity student named [Jonas](../character/jonas.md) [Blake](../character/jonas.md) and unexpectedly fell in love with him. Upon returning to college, she announced her engagement to [Jonas](../character/jonas.md), happily embracing a future as a minister's wife in the slums. During their time at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), Phil frequently offered commentary on Anne's romantic prospects and kept her informed of college gossip regarding [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Christine Stuart](../character/christine-stuart.md). Shortly after graduating from [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), Phil married [Jonas](../character/jonas.md) in her hometown of [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke) with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in attendance.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Lady P2](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0002), [v3 ch.Lady P4](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0004), [v3 ch.Lady P9](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0009), [v3 ch.Lady P13](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0013), [v3 ch.Lady P16](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0016), [v3 ch.Lady P22](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0022), +507 more_

## Quotes

> "I’ll go, if I can walk with Priscilla and Charlie. That will be a bearable degree of gooseberry. That Gilbert of yours is a darling, Anne, but why does he go around so much with Goggle-eyes?"
>
> — Phil Gordon — [v3 ch.Park P9](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0009)

> "I don’t want William’s Island especially, but I’m sure I couldn’t get it if I did. Look at that sentry on the summit of the fort, right beside the flag. Doesn’t he look as if he had stepped out of a romance?"
>
> — Phil Gordon — [v3 ch.Park P25](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0025)

> "Look—in white letters, around the archway over the gate. ‘Patty’s Place.’ Isn’t that killing? Especially on this Avenue of Pinehursts and Elmwolds and Cedarcrofts? ‘Patty’s Place,’ if you please! I adore it."
>
> — Phil Gordon — [v3 ch.Park P34](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0034)

> "They really are such dear boys, you know. There’s to be no end of dances and drives and general jamborees. I shall never forgive you, Queen Anne, for not coming home with me for the holidays."
>
> — Phil Gordon — [v3 ch.Again P2](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0002)

> "There’ll be one or two quilting parties, I suppose; and all the old gossips will talk you over to your face and behind your back. You’ll die of lonesomeness, child."
>
> — Phil Gordon — [v3 ch.Again P4](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0004)

## Relationships

### [Alec](../character/alec.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/alec--phil-gordon.md)

[Alec](../character/alec.md) is one of Phil's suitors back home whom she considers marrying. Throughout her early college years, she constantly frets over her indecisiveness between him and another admirer, keeping him in mind as a romantic option.

- Romantically involved with — suitor she is considering marrying  <sub>[v3 ch.Home P5](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0005), [v3 ch.Again P52](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0052), [v3 ch.Relationships P4](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0004), +1 more</sub>

### [Alonzo](../character/alonzo.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/alonzo--phil-gordon.md)

[Alonzo](../character/alonzo.md) is another suitor vying for Phil's hand. Like [Alec](../character/alec.md), he remains a frequent topic of Phil's lighthearted angst as she struggles to choose which suitor she truly prefers.

- Romantically involved with — suitor she is considering marrying  <sub>[v3 ch.Again P52](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0052)</sub>

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--phil-gordon.md)

Phil first meets [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in Old St. John's Cemetery during their first year at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), quickly striking up a warm friendship. They go on autumn walks, share social lives, and eventually move into Patty's Place together as housemates. Phil even brings [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to her hometown of [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke), helping her connect with the history of her late parents.

- Friend of — college chums and housemates  <sub>[v3 ch.Home P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 ch.Again P2](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0002), [v3 ch.Again P52](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0052), +11 more</sub>

### [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/aunt-jamesina--phil-gordon.md)

[Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) serves as an affectionate chaperon and mentor to Phil and the other girls living at Patty's Place. Phil shares lighthearted banter with her regarding household management, suitors, and beauty, while [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) views Phil with fond amusement despite her eccentricities.

- Friend of — affectionate guardian or mentor figure who loves her  <sub>[v3 ch.Interlude P40](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0040), [v3 ch.Jonas P5](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0005)</sub>

### [Emily](../character/emily.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/emily--phil-gordon.md)

[Cousin Emily](../character/emily.md) is Phil's relative who runs a boarding house at [Prospect Point](../codex/places.md#prospect-point). Phil stays with her during a summer break, where she meets various quirky boarders and encounters her future love interest.

- Relative of — father's second cousin  <sub>[v3 ch.Jonas P2](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0002)</sub>

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/gilbert-blythe--phil-gordon.md)

Phil and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) are fellow [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) students who participate in the same social group, spending time together on walks and house visits. They compete against one another for top honors in their Freshman classes. Phil is also present at Patty's Place shortly before [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) makes his ill-fated proposal to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).

- Rival of — competitors for top honor in Freshman classes  <sub>[v3 ch.Again P0](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0000)</sub>

### [Jonas](../character/jonas.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/jonas--phil-gordon.md)

Phil meets [Jonas](../character/jonas.md) [Blake](../character/jonas.md), a serious divinity student, while staying at [Prospect Point](../codex/places.md#prospect-point) over the summer. Though initially trying to deny her feelings because he is plain and solemn compared to her usual suitors, their days spent boating and walking on the beach lead to a deep romance, culminating in their engagement.

- Friend of — good chums who boated and walked on sands together  <sub>[v3 ch.Jonas P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012)</sub>
- Romantically involved with — engaged to be married  <sub>[v3 ch.Charming P18](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0018), [v3 ch.Christine P9](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0009), [v3 ch.Confidences P19](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0019), +3 more</sub>

### [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/phil-gordon--priscilla-grant.md)

Phil meets [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at the cemetery during their early days at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). They become good college companions, going on outings together and eventually agreeing to let Phil join her and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) as a housemate at Patty's Place.
